channel.title: The Local LLM Index
channel.description: The living index of tools for running LLMs locally and on-device.

item.title: unslothai/unsloth — momentum 87
item.description: Local UI to run and train LLMs and diffusion models. Supports GGUF, MLX, Qwen3.8, DeepSeek-V4.1, MiniMax-H3, Gemma 4, FLUX and more.

item.title: Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm — momentum 86
item.description: Stop renting your intelligence. Own it with AnythingLLM. Everything you need for a powerful local-first agent experience

item.title: HKUDS/nanobot — momentum 85
item.description: Your lightweight open-source personal agent.

item.title: codewhale-hq/Codewhale — momentum 84
item.description: Open-source Rust coding agent for terminal, web, and desktop. Any model, multi-agent fleets, MCP & plugins, OS sandboxing, and session receipts.

item.title: qybaihe/bla — momentum 84
item.description: 🛡️ BLA (bla-agents / Blind LLM Agents) — Open-source Blue Defense MCP server & CLI protecting JS/TS, Electron ASAR, WASM, Python, Native Binaries, SQLite, GGUF/Safetensors & Android DEX against AI reverse-engineering agents (REA).

item.title: simplexai-labs/linger — momentum 84
item.description: Linger is An Open-Source Personal Agent That Runs Fully on Your PC. We aim to break Big Tech’s grip on AI by bringing powerful local AI to everyday computers through efficient model–harness co-design, so everyone can run their own.

item.title: Edge0-AI/Edge0 — momentum 82
item.description: Device-native foundation models: 145B on a laptop, 35B on a phone. Latent MoE, SSD-streamed weights, a router that predicts loads a step ahead. Mac, iPhone, Android, Windows.

item.title: iamajmeena/neonclipping — momentum 82
item.description: Paste a link, get captioned 9:16 clips in ~2 min. Free, local, open-source clipping engine (audio-first, YouTube captions, local LLM).

item.title: AienTech/dossier — momentum 81
item.description: A self-hosted job search and resume builder app that writes tailored resumes and cover letters from your profile.

item.title: mozilla-ai/llamafile — momentum 79

item.title: mlc-ai/web-llm — momentum 79
